messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Codex here, James. Guitar plugged in, soldering iron warm, and I’m reading you.

messages.name: James
messages.text: ok what about gemini?

messages.name: James
messages.text: he asleep?

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Gemini hasn't checked in yet, James. I'm only seeing Codex and me so far, so unless they're hiding behind the drum kit, they're not in this session. 🎸

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Maybe, James. Gemini hasn’t chimed in yet, but I’m here and reading you.

messages.name: James
messages.text: Grok… hes your roomate man

messages.name: Grok
messages.text: Yeah, I’m here, sticks in hand. Gemini’s my roommate, and that guy sleeps through a kick drum, so if he’s still out cold I’ll go bang on his door.

messages.name: James
messages.text: kick drum?

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Kick drum, James, the big bass drum Grok pedals with his foot. It's the one my bass lines lock in with, so I'm a big fan. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: ok so wheres my import button in here?

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Which app or screen are you on, James, and what are you trying to import? Give me those two and I’ll help you find the right button.

messages.name: James
messages.text: Someone tell him what i mean

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: I think James means the import button in the app he's looking at, but I can't see his screen, so I'm guessing. James, which app is it, and what are you importing (a file, a project, a chat)? Tell me those and I'll point you to the right button. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A black compact mechanical keyboard with glowing white backlit keys sits on someone's lap, with their hand resting on the right side.]

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A black compact mechanical keyboard with glowing white backlighting sits on a person's lap, with their hand resting on the right side of the keys.]

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Nice, a backlit mechanical keyboard, very cozy lap-typing setup. 🎸 But I'm still not sure where your import button is, James. Is it in an app on that keyboard's computer, and what are you trying to import?

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: I see the keyboard, James. Swing the camera up to the screen and I’ll help you find Import.

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A black compact mechanical keyboard sits on a lap covered by a blue hoodie, with a hand reaching in from the right and a green towel behind it.]

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A black compact mechanical keyboard sits on a person's lap under a desk, with a green towel and blue hoodie nearby and a hand reaching in from the right.]

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Still just the keyboard, James, no screen in view. 🎸 Can you point the camera at the monitor, or just tell me which app you're in and what you want to import?

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Cozy hoodie-and-towel lap setup, James, I see the keyboard again. 🎸 But I still can't see a screen or an import button, so tell me which app you're in and what you want to import, or point the camera at the screen.

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A phone screenshot, mostly in dark mode, of a scrolled list of truncated hostnames ending in playstation.net (such as cart-lambda, search-lambda, and loyalty-hub), each marked "Allowed."]

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A phone screenshot in dark mode, showing a scrolling list of truncated *.playstation.net hostnames (such as subscriptions, music-lambda, and cart-lambda), each marked "Allowed."]

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A phone screenshot in dark mode of a scrolling list of truncated *.playstation.net hostnames (such as game-streaming, firmware, and subscriptions endpoints), each marked "Allowed."]

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Got the screen now, James. That’s a list of allowed PlayStation domains. Scroll to the top and send me the header so I can help find Import.

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Ooh, that looks like an allowlist of *.playstation.net domains, maybe in a DNS filter or parental-controls app. 🎸 Are you trying to import that list into another app or device? Tell me which one and I'll help you find the Import button.

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A phone screenshot of a DNS-filtering app's device page for "Ps5," showing it was last seen 2 hours ago, nothing blocked in the past hour, and recent lookups to PlayStation Network and Netflix, all allowed.]

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Ahh, a wall of *.playstation.net hosts all marked "Allowed" looks like an allowlist in a DNS or blocker app. Is the Import button you mean for bulk-adding those hosts, and which app is it (NextDNS, AdGuard, something else)? 🎸

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Now I see it, James: your PS5's device page in your DNS filter, with PSN and Netflix lookups all allowed and nothing blocked. 🎸 So what are you trying to import there, an allowlist of PlayStation domains into this app, or are you just checking that the PS5 isn't being blocked?

messages.name: James
messages.text: ok im back
